objective: On a fixed five-product pair compare a guarded proof with its expansion using the same local relations and visible coordinates; identify the deduction, the guards where it can be used, the work paid and the status of any minimum.
status: Proved: The fixed independent pair p1 and p2 XOR p3 admits an eight-case tree whose eight guarded applications use exactly six distinct terminal contradictions. Six is minimal for a terminal-guard library covering all 64 original reporting-evaluator inputs. Under the stated unit, the guarded proof uses 20 local evaluator checks, its expansion uses 24, and a direct tree uses 16.
title: Measure and replay conditional deductions reused by branches
